author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Two-Scale Quotas (k2=1 stitch per other batch)
abstract: Single-change vs SOTA: add minimal cross-batch 'stitch' edges (k2=1 per other batch) to the equal-quota balanced graph on residualized PCs. Embedding unchanged (ComBat-PCA64, tau=0.95). Hypothesis: small ARI/Graph_conn gains with mixing unchanged.
